name: Sore de mo Ore wa Yatteyaru!
original_name: それでもオレはやってやる！
source:
The main character had a wife and two children, and although he was not wealthy by any means, he built a happy family. However, one day the situation changed completely.

The main character, suspected of being a train molester, was detained by the police. Of course, this affected all his family and work. A few days later, he was released due to insufficient evidence, but what the hero lost during that time was too great. 

One day, he discovered the "Molester's Nest" on the Internet. It was a group molestation site that released the next target and gathered friends. At first, the protagonist was angry, but his thoughts changed when he saw the next target. It contained information about the woman who stole everything from the protagonist. "I have nothing to lose, at least..." The demon inside the hero whispered.

The main character registered on the site and applied for a group molester. Thus begins his crazy life.

[Edited from [url=https://www.debonosu.jp/euphoria/game/soy_rankaku/story.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
主人公有妻子和两个孩子，虽然算不上富裕，却建立了幸福家庭。然而，某天，一切都彻底改变了。

主人公因被怀疑在列车上猥亵女性而遭警方拘留。当然，这件事牵连了他的家庭与工作。几天后，他因证据不足获释，可在那段时间里失去的一切，实在太多了。

某天，他在网上发现了“痴汉巢穴”。那是一个集体猥亵网站，会公布下一个目标，并召集同伙。起初，主人公对此十分愤怒；可当他看到下一个目标时，想法改变了。目标资料中，竟有那个夺走他一切的女人。“反正我已经一无所有了……”主人公心中的恶魔低声说道。

主人公注册了网站，申请成为集体痴汉。疯狂的人生，就此开始。

[据[url=https://www.debonosu.jp/euphoria/game/soy_rankaku/story.html]官方网站[/url]编辑]
